title: Simple Planar Pendulum
description: Single-DOF compound pendulum pivoted to ground via a revolute joint with coincident markers, rotational damping, and gravitational loading.

title: Slider-Crank Reciprocating Mechanism
description: Single-cylinder reciprocating slider-crank mechanism with a constant-speed crank drive, spherical/universal connecting rod joints to prevent spatial overconstraint, and a translating piston.

title: Four-Bar Grashof Linkage with Torque Actuator
description: Crank-rocker Grashof four-bar mechanism using non-overconstrained spatial joints (revolute, spherical, universal) with a harmonic drive motion and return spring-damper.

title: Quarter-Car Double-Wishbone Suspension
description: Front-left double-wishbone (SLA) independent suspension with upper and lower control arms, steering upright, spinning wheel hub, coilover spring-damper, and an Adams/Solver ACF ride-bump simulation command deck.
code:
!------------------------------------------------------------------
! MSC Adams Dataset: Quarter-Car Double-Wishbone Suspension (SLA)
! Spatial mobility: 4 moving bodies (24 DOF)
! Joints: 3 REVOLUTE(15) + 2 SPHERICAL(6) = 21 => M = 3 DOF
!------------------------------------------------------------------
ADAMS/
!
!----------------------------------- PARTS ------------------------
PART/1, GROUND
!
! Lower control arm (LCA)
PART/2, MASS = 4.8 &
  , CM = 201 &
  , IP = 0.08, 0.10, 0.09
!
! Upper control arm (UCA)
PART/3, MASS = 3.2 &
  , CM = 301 &
  , IP = 0.05, 0.06, 0.06
!
! Steering upright / knuckle
PART/4, MASS = 8.5 &
  , CM = 401 &
  , IP = 0.12, 0.14, 0.10
!
! Wheel and tire assembly
PART/5, MASS = 22.0 &
  , CM = 501 &
  , IP = 1.15, 1.85, 1.15
!
!---------------------------------- MARKERS -----------------------
! Chassis hardpoints on Ground (Part 1)
MARKER/101, PART = 1, QP = 0.0, 0.25, 0.22, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
MARKER/102, PART = 1, QP = 0.0, 0.30, 0.52, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
MARKER/103, PART = 1, QP = 0.0, 0.38, 0.72, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
MARKER/104, PART = 1, QP = -0.14, 0.32, 0.30, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
!
! Lower control arm markers (Part 2)
MARKER/201, PART = 2, QP = 0.0, 0.45, 0.21, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
MARKER/202, PART = 2, QP = 0.0, 0.25, 0.22, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
MARKER/203, PART = 2, QP = 0.0, 0.65, 0.20, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
MARKER/204, PART = 2, QP = 0.0, 0.52, 0.23, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
!
! Upper control arm markers (Part 3)
MARKER/301, PART = 3, QP = 0.0, 0.46, 0.51, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
MARKER/302, PART = 3, QP = 0.0, 0.30, 0.52, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
MARKER/303, PART = 3, QP = 0.0, 0.62, 0.50, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
!
! Upright markers (Part 4)
MARKER/401, PART = 4, QP = 0.0, 0.68, 0.34, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
MARKER/402, PART = 4, QP = 0.0, 0.65, 0.20, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
MARKER/403, PART = 4, QP = 0.0, 0.62, 0.50, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
MARKER/404, PART = 4, QP = 0.0, 0.75, 0.33, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
MARKER/405, PART = 4, QP = -0.14, 0.66, 0.30, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
!
! Wheel hub markers (Part 5)
MARKER/501, PART = 5, QP = 0.0, 0.75, 0.33, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
MARKER/502, PART = 5, QP = 0.0, 0.75, 0.33, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
!
!----------------------------------- JOINTS -----------------------
! Chassis-to-LCA and Chassis-to-UCA bushings (modeled as revolute pivots)
JOINT/1, REVOLUTE, I = 101, J = 202
JOINT/2, REVOLUTE, I = 102, J = 302
!
! Lower and upper ball joints
JOINT/3, SPHERICAL, I = 203, J = 402
JOINT/4, SPHERICAL, I = 303, J = 403
!
! Wheel spindle bearing
JOINT/5, REVOLUTE, I = 404, J = 502
!
!----------------------------------- FORCES -----------------------
! Coilover spring-damper strut
SPRINGDAMPER/1, TRANSLATIONAL, I = 103, J = 204, K = 42000.0, C = 3200.0, LENGTH = 0.56
!
! Steering tie-rod compliance link
SPRINGDAMPER/2, TRANSLATIONAL, I = 104, J = 405, K = 180000.0, C = 450.0, LENGTH = 0.34
!
!--------------------------- SIMULATION CONTROL -------------------
ACCGRAV/KGRAV = -9.80665
SIMULATE/DYNAMIC, END = 2.5, DTOUT = 0.005
END

title: 6-DOF Robotic Manipulator Dynamics
description: Six-axis articulated industrial robotic arm with waist, shoulder, elbow, forearm roll, wrist pitch, and end-effector flange revolute joints, prescribed joint trajectory motions, and an Adams/Solver ACF control script.
code:
!------------------------------------------------------------------
! MSC Adams Dataset: 6-DOF Articulated Industrial Manipulator
! Spatial mobility: 6 moving bodies (36 DOF), 6 REVOLUTE joints (30) => M = 6 DOF
!------------------------------------------------------------------
ADAMS/
!
!----------------------------------- PARTS ------------------------
PART/1, GROUND
!
! Link 1: Base Waist Turret
PART/2, MASS = 18.0, CM = 201, IP = 0.32, 0.32, 0.28
!
! Link 2: Upper Arm (Shoulder-to-Elbow, 0.65 m)
PART/3, MASS = 12.5, CM = 301, IP = 0.45, 0.48, 0.12
!
! Link 3: Elbow Housing
PART/4, MASS = 7.2, CM = 401, IP = 0.11, 0.12, 0.08
!
! Link 4: Forearm Roll Tube (0.55 m)
PART/5, MASS = 5.4, CM = 501, IP = 0.16, 0.16, 0.05
!
! Link 5: Wrist Pitch Clevis

!
! Link 6: Tool Flange + Payload
PART/7, MASS = 4.0, CM = 701, IP = 0.04, 0.04, 0.03
!
!---------------------------------- MARKERS -----------------------

MARKER/101, PART = 1, QP = 0.0, 0.0, 0.25, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0

MARKER/601, PART = 6, QP = 0.82, 0.0, 1.10, REULER = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0

JOINT/5, REVOLUTE, I = 503, J = 602

END
